title: LightTAR: Light and Fast Target-Aware Representations for Multimodal Tabular Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.17600v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal tabular learning involves classification and regression on tables combining structured numerical and categorical features with unstructured text and images. These unstructured fields are commonly represented by pretrained encoder embeddings reduced with principal component analysis (PCA). This reduction prioritizes input variance but may overlook information relevant to predicting the target. We introduce LightTAR, a simple, inexpensive method that adapts dimensionality reduction to the prediction task. LightTAR augments the standard PCA representation with a few target-aware features extracted jointly from the final and an intermediate encoder layer using regularized partial least squares (PLS). We evaluate LightTAR with 21 tabular models, including tree ensembles, neural networks, and tabular foundation models. LightTAR improves average predictive performance for all models and, averaged across models, improves prediction

translated_title: LightTAR：用于多模态表格学习的轻量快速目标感知表示
translated_abstract: 多模态表格学习涉及对同时包含结构化数值与类别特征以及非结构化文本和图像的表格进行分类和回归。这些非结构化字段通常由预训练编码器的嵌入来表示，并使用主成分分析（PCA）进行降维。这种降维优先保留输入方差，但可能忽略与预测目标相关的信息。我们提出了LightTAR，这是一种简单且低开销的方法，能够使降维过程与预测任务相适应。LightTAR利用正则化偏最小二乘（PLS）从编码器的最后一层和某一中间层联合提取少量目标感知特征，以此增广标准的PCA表示。我们使用21种表格模型对LightTAR进行了评估，包括树集成模型、神经网络以及表格基础模型。LightTAR提升了所有模型的平均预测性能，并且在跨模型的平均意义上改善了预测……
tldr: LightTAR是一种简单低成本的降维增强方法，它利用正则化PLS从编码器最后一层和中间层提取目标感知特征来补充标准PCA表示，从而在21种表格模型上普遍提升多模态表格学习的预测性能。
en_tdlr: LightTAR is a simple, low-cost method that augments standard PCA representations with target-aware features extracted via regularized PLS from the final and intermediate encoder layers, improving predictive performance across 21 tabular models in multimodal tabular learning.
